definitions.binary_scored_rows: Rows with valid binary target and valid prediction used in Brier/logloss/accuracy/AUC scoring.
definitions.warmup_rows: Rows explicitly flagged by the walk-forward engine as warm-up because insufficient eligible prior training/validation history existed.
definitions.tie_or_nonbinary_rows: Rows not usable for binary win/loss scoring because the target is not binary (tie / null target), but which are not necessarily warm-up rows.

explanation: Earlier Task 03C reporting used total_rows minus scored_rows as a shorthand for warm-up rows, producing 291. The accepted conservative prediction slice (derived directly from the immutable parquet) shows 288 true warm-up-flagged rows and 3 tie/non-binary rows (target null, not warm-up). No model, prediction, training chronology, candidate selection, metrics, bootstrap, or canonical runner changed. This is a reporting/accounting semantics correction only.
